name: TC-867: @scenario S5 Day-of-week combo — valid only on another day it is not offered (lima, wind, public list); moved to today it is orderable
description: Hour-independent (the nightly runs around 02:00 New York and on weekends): days, not times. Build: Combo price → Rice Bowl + Fries, $13.99, When? → only TOMORROW's weekday (restaurant zone, all day), Save and turn on. Read back: that one day, no time window. Not today → the public v2 list does not offer it (server contract: absent, not 'listed unavailable'); lima and wind receive that list (the page's own /active response, the positive control) and show no card for it, and opening its builder directly says 'Deal not found'. Edit: the day becomes TODAY only → the v2 list offers it with availableNow true, both storefronts list it, build it and price it at $13.99 (You're saving $15.99 − $13.99). Skipped within 2 minutes of midnight in the restaurant zone, where 'today' would change mid-test.
